pages.text: The $(l)Zero Ring$() freezes water and lays down snow. Craft it from snow blocks, snowballs, Dark Matter and an Iron Band. It fits the ring curio slot.$(br2)Toggle it with $(l)G$(); press $(l)V$() to charge it and right-click to freeze instantly.$(br2)$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)While active it freezes water and covers the ground in snow around you, and it costs no EMC.$(li)Right-click freezes an area immediately, and the higher the charge the larger the radius.$(li)On a pedestal it freezes the surroundings and puts out burning creatures on a timer.
